task_text: Hold the tray by both handles, one gripper on each, and keep the ball on the tray until the episode ends. Success: once both handles are gripped, an 11-second countdown starts; you keep holding both handles, one gripper on each, with the ball on the tray, until it completes, and the ball is still on the tray when the episode ends. The episode fails at once if the ball leaves the tray or a handle is let go during the countdown.
